results: 1. Genetic testing for CAG trinucleotide repeat expansion in the HTT gene
genetic testing (targeted panel or exome): NOTCH2NLC GGC repeat expansion - genetically confirmed NIID
2. MRI of the brain with attention to the basal ganglia
3. Peripheral blood smear to look for acanthocytes
copper / caeruloplasmin / 24 h urinary copper: normal - excludes Wilson disease
5. Comprehensive metabolic panel including liver function tests and creatine kinase
serum electrolytes, urea and creatinine: normal
serum calcium, magnesium and phosphate: normal
dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Neuronal Intranuclear Inclusion Disease (NIID) due to pathogenic GGC repeat expansion in the NOTCH2NLC gene

1. Huntington's disease (despite negative HTT testing, repeat expansion disorders can have phenocopies)
2. Chorea-acanthocytosis (not excluded due to unavailable acanthocyte testing)
3. Other NOTCH2NLC-related repeat expansion disorders (e.g., FMR1, RFC1) presenting with overlapping movement and cognitive features
